retry: PASS. Verified no in-session retry exists: each contact tap is a one-shot, idempotent action (tapping an already-contacted card's card does nothing further since its button is gone), and the whole session resolves in a single share() call with no live-retry path back into the playing view -- this is the core select-all/free-reorder fix from the reverse audit. The non-scored reflection step (Gate G) was verified separately: the continue button starts disabled, stays disabled after a partial reflection pick, and only enables once all 3 reflection choices are made; the picked reflection order has no bearing on onPartialComplete firing.
